confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from one search of aggregated Numbeo-based figures (Expatica, June 2026; other cost-of-living sites). They gave beer at about EUR 5.2, cappuccino at about EUR 4.1, an inexpensive meal at about EUR 17.2 and a mid-range meal for two at about EUR 83. I converted EUR to USD at roughly 1.16, which is an assumption. No cocktail or by-the-glass wine prices were found. Cocktail is estimated at about 2.3 times beer and wine glass at about 1.2 times beer, based on typical German bar pricing. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates, with no listings checked. Frankfurt hotel prices swing sharply with trade fairs. The FX figure is the RBA observation corroborated in the overview page and RSS feed. A 19 November figure appeared in the daily table, but it looked provisional, so I used 18 November.
comparable_city_reasoning: Frankfurt is a pricey German business and finance hub. I assumed it is comparable to Munich or Cologne, slightly above the German average for restaurants.
